blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation applied to Smart Cities & Infrastructure. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Cities orchestrate mobility, energy, safety and services on shared telemetry — with privacy-by-design as the non-negotiable. The platform pattern (open data contracts, event fabric, measured outcomes) beats vendor lock-in towers every time.

items: Faults reported by citizens; maintenance unscheduled.
Lighting/traffic/water systems vendor-locked; data not shared.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Intelligent Document Processing, Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration, Intelligent Document Processing from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Urban asset management, Mobility optimization, Public-space governance) on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — GDPR among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Agents operated as one fleet: roles, queues, budgets and audit trails.
Decision paths that run in milliseconds, with policy checks and full logging.
Contracts, claims and invoices read end-to-end: extraction, validation and downstream action.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Public Sector & Government level this capability reads as: cross-agency analytics scoring anomalies with investigator case packs (capture up at stable load). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
